scripts.dev:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f api worker web
scripts.dev:cli: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps api npx tsx api/src/cli/index.ts
scripts.dev:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm dbmate up
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f api worker
scripts.prod:cli: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --no-deps api node api/dist/cli/index.js
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm migrate up
